review_evidence: This AFP hash-partition contains 374 primary Isabelle theories; 356 contain 11,746 theorem/definition/function/datatype/locale/class-family declarations under a broad structural scan.

The partition spans independent Archive of Formal Proofs entries in data structures, modal logic, rewriting, geometry, p-adics, graph algorithms, semantics, distributed systems, and verification; the declaration-light subset consists of import roots, introductions/conclusions, interface modules, and examples.

Direct inspection of CoreC++/CoreC++.thy and other declaration-light entry modules confirms that they carry theory ownership/import structure even without local declarations; no shared selector can remove them without losing useful retrieval context.
